The EU Cyber Resilience Act is bringing new requirements for software, and open source developers, organizations, and businesses need to be ready.

On September 10 at #EuroBSDCon2026, join Alice Sowerby, Peter Hansteen, and Pierre Pronchery for the full-day tutorial, “The Night Before CRAmas – Why EU Regulations Are a Gift to Open Source.”

📅 September 10, 2026
📍 EuroBSDCon 2026 | Brussels, Belgium

Learn more and register:
https://events.eurobsdcon.org/2026/talk/RER8UZ/

#FreeBSD #OpenSource
